title: Show and keep the effort a Claude Code launch runs with

intentCoverage.report:
Dough Intent Coverage: SEED-388#show-the-effort-a-launch-runs-with at c741f265f6f52bb2cb2c5b239bc1733c5e3568b6

Verdict: Caught.

Promise: every Claude Code session the dashboard starts passes an explicit effort; an untouched launch starts with `--effort medium` and its launch record keeps `medium` (Scope bullet 1; key examples "Default launch" and "Feedback maintenance"). Caller's suggested promise, fault and command held at this revision and were used unchanged.

Fault: dashboard/server/agentLaunchAccept.ts, `withDefaultEffort` made to return the request unchanged (inserted `if (request.host !== undefined || true) return request;` as its first line). No fixture or assertion touched. Restoration was armed with an EXIT trap (`git checkout -- <file>`).

Scratch: detached worktree of c741f265 at /Users/terryyin/.claude/jobs/fa9d77b7/tmp/intent-scratch, `npm ci` on node v24.21.0; pre-probe `git status --porcelain` empty.

Command: `caffeinate -s -i env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES npx playwright test --config dashboard/backend.playwright.config.ts --reporter=list launches/agent-launch-model-boundary.spec.ts launches/feedback-maintenance-launch.spec.ts`

Runs:
- Baseline: 22 passed (18.1s), including "passes Open Dough's default effort when none is chosen, and its record keeps it" and the feedback-maintenance default-effort test, so both exercised the path.
- Faulted: 2 failed, 2 passed, 18 skipped. The boundary spec runs in serial mode, so its first failure skipped the rest. Wrong behavior was seen independently in the received argv: the story launch argv went `--model opus` and then straight to the `/dough-execute-plan ...` prompt with no `--effort medium`. The feedback-maintenance argv went `--model opus` and then the `/maintain-feedback-cycle ...` prompt with no effort. Catching assertions:
  1. agent-launch-model-boundary.spec.ts:74, the exact-argv `toEqual` in "starts a story session on the chosen model before its instruction and keeps the alias" (expected `--effort`, `medium`; received none).
  2. feedback-maintenance-launch.spec.ts:47, the `argv.slice(3, 7)` check in "a session started at Open Dough's default effort: ..." (expected `--model opus --effort medium`; received `--model opus` and then the prompt).
- Faulted, targeted (`-g "default effort when none is chosen"`): 1 failed. agent-launch-model-boundary.spec.ts:159 `expect(story.argv?.slice(3, 5)).toEqual(["--effort", "medium"])` received the `/dough-execute-plan SEED-052#...` prompt instead. This is the untouched-default story path with no model. Its record assertion at :161 was not reached, so whether the record check alone catches the fault was not observed.
- Restored: diff reverted by the trap, `git status --porcelain` empty, HEAD still c741f265. Rerun: 22 passed (8.1s). Scratch worktree removed with `git worktree remove`.

Claim limits: observed on backend-boundary paths only: a story launch with a model, an untouched story launch with no model, and feedback maintenance on Claude Code with Opus. The ad-hoc branch of the default-effort test (:163-168) and the UI dialog/Session details were not reached under the fault. The partial fault (default applied only for ad-hoc) was not run separately. It would still break the story-path assertions observed above.

Next proof action: none needed for this promise on the paths observed. Optionally, to observe the record-keeps-effort assertion (:161) on its own, rerun with :159 temporarily bypassed. This is not required by the verdict.

Load: load average 14.15 at baseline, 9.52 after the restored run. Run times are comparative only.

Costs:
- Test runtime: measured, from the Playwright runner's summary: baseline 18.1s, faulted 7.5s, faulted targeted under 1s (the test took 218ms; the summary line was not captured), restored 8.1s. Total about 34s of runner time. npm ci is excluded.
- Human effort: unavailable. No human interaction occurred during this delegated run, and no separate measure exists.
- Agent effort: unavailable. No token or tool-time meter is exposed to this agent. About 12 tool calls were made (count estimated).
- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 115191 ms (measured), from 1794820941000 to 1794821056191 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

Wrap-up disposition: c741f265f6f52bb2cb2c5b239bc1733c5e3568b6 — Caught — no follow-up.
